# The Host Bali

> Direct-booking site for 6 private villas in Bali (Umalas, Sanur) — all managed by our own team, not an aggregator. Guests book commission-free via WhatsApp (+6281239081021), or via Airbnb / Booking.com. Rates on request — same-day quote on WhatsApp.
